notes.title: Update - Difficulty Modify
notes.content:
Hi Kids,

We have modified the difficulty of the game. 
In "Normal" and "Easy" games, the running speed of adults will be slower. It is suitable for players who are not yet familiar with Gotcha. 


Happy Gotcha

notes.title: Update - Steam Cloud
notes.content:
Hell Kids,

The steam cloud added today, some of you guys will not found your save data.
You could find your save data from this path below:
"C:/Users/<your user name>/AppData/LocalLow/DefaultCompany/Gotcha"

The name of save data will be
1. SaveData1.dat
2. SaveData2.dat
3. SaveData3.dat

Before running "Gotcha", move this files to the path below:
"C:/Users/<your user name>/AppData/LocalLow/Kidom/Gotcha"

Please tell us if you have any other question.
Thank you for your support!

Happy Gotcha!
